title: Audemars Piguet Overlay Menu
description: Fullscreen overlay menu opened from a hamburger toggle: two background halves pre-rotated 180deg with scale(2) sweep in like closing doors on a custom cubic-bezier ease while the bars morph into an X, then SplitText-masked menu links and footer lines slide up with staggered power3.out reveals. Clicking the toggle again reverses the same paused timeline to close.

images.desc: macro photograph of a bare mechanical watch movement — steel bridges, jewels and gear train — resting on dark slate with a soft-focus second movement behind, low-key moody lighting; dark negative space at frame-left for headline legibility
images.role: fullscreen hero background behind the menu

intent.useWhen: Úsalo cuando quieras un menú overlay a pantalla completa de lujo, con tipografía serif refinada y enlaces que se revelan al abrir el hamburguesa.
